newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel steady, barges sold into cargoes.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel steady, barges sold into cargoes.

text.p: NWE jet fuel cargo premiums were steady in thin volumes on Thursday with trade restricted to barge selling into cargoes, mainly on Scandinavian demand, traders said.
Benchmark Dec IPE futures advanced $5.75 to $229.75 a tonne, lifted by stronger Brent crude oil and a range of positive fundamental news
Cargo premiums were steady at Dec IPE +$36 cif NWE, with most demand focused on dual purpose kerosene and very high flash. Barges remained around Dec IPE +$27 fob ARA.
In the Med a cargo was traded out of Spain around quotes high fob +$6.50, around unchanged.
